branches.name: Live Fault
branches.description: A Fault Line that runs under an enemy you are Resonating breaks the resonance at once (Shatter's blow) and throws them twice as high.

branches.name: Seismic Lance
branches.description: An uppercut, and a moment later a column of earth bursts up under one enemy within 24 blocks (its feet are marked first): 7 + level damage, thrown straight up. An enemy already in the air is smashed back down instead, for double. +10 Strain.

branches.name: Deep Roots
branches.description: Earthquake's fissures run half again as far, and your Fault Lines climb one-block steps and cross deeper drops instead of stopping.

branches.name: Fault Script
branches.description: Trail a hand along the ground and write a twelve-step fault ahead of you. It glows brighter until it erupts two seconds later, hitting each enemy once. A Shockwave fired along it sets it off at once.

branches.name: Short Fuse
branches.description: Fault Script erupts after one second instead of two.

branches.name: Undertow
branches.description: Your written fault returns for a second pass after its first wave, dragging what it hits back toward you.

branches.name: Pressure Skin
branches.description: While you are braced (Counterforce), holding Quake Blast or inside your Vibration Shell, a shot or bullet that reaches you shakes apart on your skin instead (+4 Strain).

branches.name: Vibration Shell
branches.description: Cross your arms, then fling them out: the air round you shakes into a shell 3 blocks across for 4 seconds. Bullets that reach it shake apart, explosives go off outside it, other shots turn back, and enemies who push in are thrown out. +10 Strain.

branches.name: Kinetic Sink
branches.description: Every bullet, shot or explosive your blasts and shell break, turn back or set off bleeds 3 Strain away instead of adding to it.

branches.name: Counterforce
branches.description: Cross your forearms and brace for five seconds, absorbing half of incoming damage into a counterwave. Cast again to release it as a double-palm push, or throw a Shockwave to pour it out through the blast. Stored force releases at expiry.

branches.name: Counter Balance
branches.description: Counterforce absorbs 70% of incoming damage instead of 50%.

branches.name: Stolen Thunder
branches.description: Your counterwave can release up to 24 damage, and stored force kicks you opposite your aim for an escape or launch.

branches.name: Sympathetic Frequency
branches.description: A Resonate that runs its full course jumps once to the nearest enemy within 6 blocks and shakes it for another second and a half.

branches.name: Pressure Step
branches.description: Fling both palms back at the air behind you and shoot about eight blocks along your aim. A ring goes off where you left, hitting and shoving back anyone there; your landing is cushioned. +8 Strain.

branches.name: Read the Pulse
branches.description: Every hostile heartbeat Tremor Sense lets you feel is marked for five seconds: your next quake on it lands 25% harder.

branches.name: Surgical Fracture
branches.description: Lay a palm on a wall up to 24 blocks away and open a small seam: cracks run out from your hand. Only ordinary blocks of hardness 2 or less fracture; containers are spared.

branches.name: Wider Incision
branches.description: Surgical Fracture examines twelve blocks instead of six.

branches.name: Master Incision
branches.description: Surgical Fracture reaches ordinary material up to hardness 4. This precise technique does not add fresh Sylar attention.

styles.name: Fissure Maw
styles.description: Split the ground in a line 14 blocks long in front of you. Slabs heave up either side of a glowing crack, and foes along it take 10 + 2 per tier and are hurled into the air.

styles.name: Stone Rampart
styles.description: Slabs of rock burst up in an arc in front of you for 10 seconds. They stop projectiles from that side and push back anyone who comes at you through them.

styles.name: Bedrock Stance
styles.description: The ground ripples outward from you. You and friends within 10 blocks cannot be knocked back and take less damage for 8 seconds.

branches.name: Featherlight
branches.description: Cushion visible teammates within 18 blocks. Falls of up to 10 blocks deal no damage; larger falls deal half damage.

branches.name: Rescue Rush
branches.description: Rush to a visible teammate or your tamed pet within 18 blocks, reset their fall and grant 8 seconds of Slow Falling plus two hearts of absorption.

branches.name: Tandem Lift
branches.description: Rescue Rush lifts both of you on an upward gust and banks 15 Momentum for your next maneuver.

branches.name: Wind Sanctuary
branches.description: Aim at solid ground within 20 blocks to shelter a 5-block area for 6 seconds. Friends land softly; incoming hostile projectiles slow and turn outward once. Shift + key dismisses it.

branches.name: Safe Harbor
branches.description: Wind Sanctuary heals each friend one heart once per cast and grants Resistance I while they remain inside.

branches.name: Last-Second Save
branches.description: Once every 45 seconds, catch a visible teammate within 18 blocks after a fall over 10 blocks. Negate their landing damage and grant 5 seconds of Slow Falling. Bank 25 Momentum if you are flying.

branches.name: Ram Air
branches.description: Build Momentum 30% faster during real forward flight at a faster wheel setting.

branches.name: Barrel Roll
branches.description: Corkscrew for 0.6 seconds, carrying your entry speed. Deflect a hostile projectile to bank 15 Momentum once per roll. Shift + key rolls left. Solid walls stop the roll.

branches.name: Vector Control
branches.description: Skyburst fully coils in 0.9 seconds instead of 1.5, letting you redirect your airspeed sooner.

branches.name: Jetstream
branches.description: Lay a 12-block wind lane for 8 seconds. Friends gain Speed II, Jump Boost and Slow Falling; enemies are carried along it. Solid terrain clips its reach. Shift + key dismisses it.

branches.name: Draft Rider
branches.description: Jetstream reaches 20 blocks. While you are flying, the first friend other than you to ride a current banks 20 Momentum for you, once per cast.

branches.name: Slipstream Echo
branches.description: A Skyburst that spends at least 50 Momentum leaves an 8-block wind lane for 4 seconds, letting friends follow your launch.

branches.name: Pressure Tap
branches.description: A successful airborne melee hit during Flight banks 5 Momentum, at most once every half second. Power damage and friendly hits do not count.

branches.name: Thermal Lance
branches.description: Aim at solid ground within 20 blocks. After 0.4 seconds, a 3.5-block-radius updraft lifts and damages enemies and cushions allies. Fly into your own column to gain a lift and 20 Momentum once per cast. Shift + key cancels the warning.

branches.name: Rising Pressure
branches.description: Thermal Lance sends a second lifting pulse 0.4 seconds after the first, holding enemies aloft for your follow-up.

branches.name: Vacuum Clap
branches.description: Draw visible enemies inward for 0.4 seconds, then clap out a 6-block pressure wave. Release spends Momentum for a harder burst. Shift + key cancels before release and keeps Momentum.

branches.name: Eye of the Storm
branches.description: Vacuum Clap reaches 9 blocks and brakes incoming hostile projectiles during its wind-up.

branches.name: Sonic Bloom
branches.description: Meteor Drop and Vacuum Clap echo once after 0.6 seconds: a second pressure wave deals half damage within 90% of the original radius.

styles.name: Tempest Drill
styles.description: Corkscrew forward 18 blocks in half a second inside a tunnel of wind. Foes you pass through take 9 + 2 per tier and are flung aside.

styles.name: Gale Wall
styles.description: A wall of wind wheels around you for 8 seconds, throwing projectiles back the way they came and pushing anyone close out of it.

styles.name: Formation Flight
styles.description: Lift everyone near you. You and friends within 12 blocks get a burst upward, fall gently, run faster and jump higher for 10 seconds.

branches.name: Architectural Memory
branches.description: Glacial Sculpt constructs last four seconds longer, preserving their original terrain until they melt.

branches.name: Crystal Lance
branches.description: Forge a crystal lance for 0.6 seconds, then launch it up to forty blocks. Its physical impact builds Frost, freezes prepared targets, and shatters frozen enemies. Cover stops its flight.

branches.name: Fracture Lines
branches.description: Shattering your sculpted ice spreads Frost to nearby visible enemies, preparing the next freeze.

branches.name: Rime Loom
branches.description: Grow a sixteen-block temporary ice path one segment at a time. Aim and press again while it grows to bend the remaining weave. Each segment lasts twelve seconds and restores its original terrain.

branches.name: Double Weave
branches.description: The growing Rime Loom is three blocks wide, and Glacier Ride lays a wider ribbon for companions.

branches.name: Suspension Stitch
branches.description: Extend the growing weave to twenty-four segments. Guiding it upward stitches bounded ascending stairs into the path.

branches.name: Sure Footing
branches.description: Glacier Ride responds more steadily to steering and braking, helping you hold a controlled line.

branches.name: Frost Armor
branches.description: Raise six orbiting ice plates for eight seconds. Each catches a hostile projectile or absorbs part of an impact; heat melts plates faster. Press again to launch the remaining plates as an aimed shard fan.

branches.name: Cold Wake
branches.description: Actual Glacier Ride movement leaves cold in your wake, building Frost on nearby enemies.

branches.name: Stillheart Cocoon
branches.description: Shelter yourself or a willing friend in a pressure-bearing ice cocoon. Its finite shell absorbs impacts, then opens with recovery and a harmless-to-allies Frost pulse. Press again to open early; Shift targets yourself.

branches.name: Sterile Ice
branches.description: A Stillheart Cocoon removes harmful status effects when its shell forms.

branches.name: Second Spring
branches.description: Opening Stillheart restores six health plus stored-pressure recovery, and also heals nearby visible friends.

branches.name: Hoarfrost
branches.description: Ice Blast builds Frost faster, letting sustained cold form a brittle shell sooner.

branches.name: Cold Snap
branches.description: Send an expanding cold front across seven blocks. Fresh enemies gain Frost, prepared targets freeze, and already frozen enemies shatter. The travelling front strikes each enemy once and stops at cover.

branches.name: Echoing Fracture
branches.description: A deliberate prison shatter spreads a brief Frost pulse to nearby enemies, setting up another frozen opening.

branches.name: Brittle Constellation
branches.description: Mark up to four visible enemies with crystal stars. Frost applied to one feeds the other visible links. Shattering a frozen star sends a staged fracture chain between them; solid cover breaks the chain.

branches.name: Long Winter
branches.description: The Frost-sharing crystal network lasts ten seconds instead of six.

branches.name: Shattered Sky
branches.description: Constellation fractures deal seven damage instead of four and briefly refreeze prepared surviving mobs.

styles.name: Hailstorm
styles.description: A storm cloud gathers over a point up to 30 blocks away and hammers it with hail for four seconds. Foes within 5 blocks are struck again and again, slowed and chilled.

styles.name: Crystal Bastion
styles.description: Crystal pillars burst up in a ring around you for 8 seconds. They shatter incoming projectiles, push foes back out of the ring, and you resist damage while they stand.

styles.name: Aurora Veil
styles.description: Curtains of aurora hang over you for 10 seconds. Friends beneath them, within 8 blocks, regenerate and cannot burn; foes there are slowed.

branches.name: Voltage Control
branches.description: Reduce activation stamina costs by 10%.

branches.name: Arc Lance
branches.description: Shock a target up to 40 blocks away for 8 + level damage, briefly stagger it, then arc to two nearby enemies.

branches.name: Voltage Control Mastery
branches.description: Reduce activation stamina costs by another 15% (25% total).

branches.name: Circuit Thread
branches.description: Trace up to 48 connected iron, copper, chain, or lightning-rod blocks. Enemies touching the network are shocked once. Can overload the annex relay partition.

branches.name: Live Wire
branches.description: Circuit Thread reaches enemies within 2.5 blocks of its conductors instead of 1.5.

branches.name: Copper Choir
branches.description: Circuit Thread can jump a single air block between aligned conductors.

branches.name: High Voltage
branches.description: Increase your outgoing attack damage by 10% while your awakened power is active.

branches.name: Static Screen
branches.description: Leave a 6-second electric screen that reflects incoming projectiles within 7 blocks.

branches.name: High Voltage Mastery
branches.description: Increase outgoing attack damage by another 15% (25% total). Suppressed during an Eclipse.

branches.name: Ground Sink
branches.description: Leave an eight-second grounding field. Nearby allies shed 40% of incoming projectile damage into it. Cast again to discharge up to 16 stored damage nearby.

branches.name: Insulated Roots
branches.description: Ground Sink remains for twelve seconds instead of eight.

branches.name: Faraday Garden
branches.description: Your grounding field absorbs 65% of allied projectile damage instead of 40%.

branches.name: Blackout
branches.description: Drink the grid: for a second every machine and live circuit near you arcs into you, then a 20-block pulse kills redstone, drains and stops Forge Energy machines and seizes Create shafts for 12 seconds. Enemies within 12 blocks are shocked and plunged into darkness. What you drain becomes Charge.

branches.name: Quick Circuit
branches.description: Reduce ability cooldowns by 10%.

branches.name: Overcharge
branches.description: Electrify your reflexes: Speed II and Haste II for 8 seconds, and fill your Charge to Overcharged.

branches.name: Quick Circuit Mastery
branches.description: Reduce ability cooldowns by another 15% (25% total).

branches.name: Arc Lattice
branches.description: Place up to three anchors by aiming at surfaces. Connecting wires shock each crossing enemy once; anchors must be within 24 blocks of one another.

branches.name: Closed Circuit
branches.description: Your lattice lasts fifteen seconds instead of nine.

branches.name: Storm Geometry
branches.description: A lattice crossing deals 10 damage instead of 6.

styles.name: Tesla Spire
styles.description: Raise a coil on a mast up to 20 blocks away. For 6 seconds it strikes the three nearest foes within 9 blocks twice a second, for 4 damage each and a moment's slowness.

styles.name: Faraday Cage
styles.description: A cage of lightning closes around you for 6 seconds. It burns projectiles out of the air, and anyone who strikes you is shocked for 4 and slowed.

styles.name: Jumpstart
styles.description: Current leaps from you through up to five friends within reach. Each heals 6, is freed of slowness and weakness and gains speed for 6 seconds; you heal 4.

branches.name: Soft Landing
branches.description: Gently placing a gripped creature gives it five seconds of Slow Falling. Shift + Grip places instead of throwing.

branches.name: Vector Lance
branches.description: Launch a visible stone lance along your crosshair. It travels up to 40 blocks, collides with cover, and deals 8 damage.

branches.name: Thread the Needle
branches.description: Vector Lance pierces its first creature and can hit a second creature behind it.

branches.name: Remote Hand
branches.description: Pull a loose item along your sightline or operate a lever, button, door, trapdoor, gate or bell up to 24 blocks away.

branches.name: Long Reach
branches.description: Remote Hand reaches 48 blocks, and Grip reaches eight blocks farther.

branches.name: Retrieve
branches.description: Remote Hand extracts one stack from an unlocked container you can edit. The actual stack flies back to you and can be intercepted.

branches.name: Salvage Orbit
branches.description: Successful Push and Disarm gather a transient stone fragment beside you, up to three. Your next Push launches an available fragment.

branches.name: Gravity Well
branches.description: Anchor a five-second pull at your crosshair, gathering nearby enemies. Press again to release them upward; Shift cancels safely.

branches.name: Crossfire
branches.description: A thrown enemy hitting a wall or ground flicks an orbiting fragment at another nearby enemy.

branches.name: Kinetic Volley
branches.description: Gather three visible fragments and launch them in sequence at your aimed point. Each deals 4 damage and collides with creatures and cover.

branches.name: Five Fragments
branches.description: Your orbit holds five fragments and Kinetic Volley launches five shots.

branches.name: Iron Rain
branches.description: Shift + Kinetic Volley lobs a physical arcing barrage. Landing fragments create small pressure waves; ceilings and cover can stop them.

branches.name: Grounding
branches.description: Vector Step stores one safe landing for five seconds. The landing consumes the protection.

branches.name: Vector Step
branches.description: Press against a temporary force foothold to vault forward and upward. Shift reverses the vault. Movement collides normally with the world.

branches.name: Counterstep
branches.description: During the first moment of Vector Step, your moving force foothold deflects incoming hostile projectiles.

branches.name: Force Bubble
branches.description: A moving three-block shell deflects incoming hostile projectiles and pushes enemies out for six seconds. Press again for an outward release; Shift cancels.

branches.name: Forward Bastion
branches.description: Your shell grows to four blocks. Shift + Force Bubble anchors it at your crosshair to defend an ally or passage.

branches.name: Counterbattery
branches.description: Force Bubble lasts ten seconds and redirects intercepted hostile projectiles toward your current crosshair.

styles.name: Implosion
styles.description: Fold space in on a point up to 24 blocks away. For a second foes within 6 blocks are dragged in with the rubble, then everything near the centre is crushed for 12 + 2 per tier and slammed down.

styles.name: Debris Halo
styles.description: Two rings of rubble whirl around you for 8 seconds. They catch projectiles and batter anyone who comes close.

styles.name: Gathering Hand
styles.description: Haul every friend within 16 blocks to your side and close a bubble of force around each of you: strong damage resistance for 5 seconds.

branches.name: Whispered Orders
branches.description: A Suggestion to a mind you hold a 30+ Focus thread to lasts twenty seconds instead of ten, and giving it deepens the thread by 20.

branches.name: Drop It
branches.description: Point two fingers and push one word into a mind up to 20 blocks away. A mob forgets its target and can't attack or shoot for four seconds (one you hold a 60+ thread to drops what it's holding); a player's hands won't obey for two: no attacks, no items.

branches.name: Strings Attached
branches.description: Let a possessed mob go and it keeps fighting your enemies for fifteen seconds. A possessed player you let go is slowed and can't strike you for three.

branches.name: Persuasion
branches.description: Speak softly into a mind up to 16 blocks away for two seconds; if it stays in your sight, it's won over. A mob follows you and fights your enemies for thirty seconds, a villager gives you a hero's discount, and a hostile player can't strike you for six seconds. A mind you hold a 60+ thread to turns at once.

branches.name: Silver Tongue
branches.description: Persuasion reaches 24 blocks and takes one second. Enemies within eight blocks of a persuaded mob turn on it instead of you.

branches.name: Eden's Voice
branches.description: Persuasion speaks to every mind you hold a 30+ thread to at once (up to four more), and a persuaded player can't strike you for ten seconds.

branches.name: Open Book
branches.description: You know where a mind you've read will move: your hits on it land 20% harder at 30 Focus and 40% harder at 60.

branches.name: Far Hearing
branches.description: Fingers to both temples: for thirty seconds you hear every voice within 160 blocks. Players talking on voice chat reach you from the direction they're in, fainter the farther they are and clear when you face them, each marked for you alone; with no one talking, things hunting within 48 blocks whisper where they are. Press again to stop.

branches.name: Eavesdropper
branches.description: Far Hearing reaches 320 blocks, and a voice you face while it speaks is threaded: Focus on its speaker builds to 30, as if you were reading them.

branches.name: Memory Walk
branches.description: Walk back through a mind up to 24 blocks away: its path over the last thirty seconds shows for you alone as fading footsteps, an echo stands where it was, and whoever hurt it is named. Aim at a place instead to see everyone who passed through it.

branches.name: Deep Read
branches.description: Memory Walk reaches back a whole minute, and walking a mind leaves you a 40-Focus thread to it.

branches.name: Lost in Thought
branches.description: Memory Walk makes an enemy relive what you walked: a mob wanders back along its own trail for six seconds and can't pick a target; a player is lost in it, slowed and their sight clouded, for four seconds.

branches.name: Shared Burden
branches.description: While you share a Mind Link or Hive Link with a friend, your Strain falls twice as fast and possession builds it half as fast.

branches.name: Dream Double
branches.description: Plant a private illusion in a player’s mind: your clone, an approaching zombie or creeper, a false chest, or a small shelter. Contact or interaction dissolves it.

branches.name: Waking Fright
branches.description: A mind that walks into or touches one of your illusions panics: it's thrown back, slowed and Shaken, and your next hit on it deals 6 more.

branches.name: Hive Link
branches.description: A Mind Link that lasts: up to six willing friends within 24 blocks (teammates, or anyone crouching) for ten minutes, through deaths and other dimensions. Linked minds hear each other's voices inside their heads from anywhere, see each other through walls, and see a halo over each friend that swells while they speak and flares red when they're badly hurt.

branches.name: Shared Senses
branches.description: Whatever hunts a linked mind glows for the whole link, and a whisper tells each of you what it is and where.

branches.name: Mind Network
branches.description: Your voice reaches inside the head of every player you hold a 30+ thread to, anywhere in the world, and theirs comes back to you. With your inner voice on, only they hear you: a conversation no one else knows is happening.

styles.name: Psychic Storm
styles.description: A storm of thought wheels over a point up to 24 blocks away for 6 seconds. Foes within 6 blocks take psychic damage, reel and turn on one another, and every second in it threads them 10 Focus deeper.

styles.name: Blind Spot
styles.description: Slip out of every mind around you. Anything hunting you within 16 blocks loses you, and nothing can pick you out for 5 seconds.

styles.name: Hive Mind
styles.description: Link up to six of you within 14 blocks for 10 seconds. Damage any of you takes is shared out evenly among the others, and teammates and crouching volunteers in it hear each other's voices from anywhere.

branches.name: Shared Blood
branches.description: Friends you heal with Blood Gift, Blood Stream, Bloodletting or Second Life are bonded to you for six seconds, as if by Blood Bond: you take 35% of their wounds.

branches.name: Bloodletting
branches.description: Cut your palm and fling a fan of blood six blocks ahead. Friends it splashes heal 4 + level and lose their harmful effects (each gives you 4 Regrowth); the undead it splashes burn for the same. Costs 2 health.

branches.name: Scar Tissue
branches.description: Every wound you take for someone else (Blood Bond, Shared Blood, Take the Wound, Martyr) gives twice the Regrowth.

branches.name: Take the Wound
branches.description: Lay a palm on a friend's wound and draw it into yourself: heal them up to 8 and take half of it as your own wound.

branches.name: Martyr's Grace
branches.description: You take only a quarter of the wound.

branches.name: Martyr
branches.description: Once every two minutes, take a killing blow meant for a teammate within eight blocks.

branches.name: Reckless Abandon
branches.description: Your Reckless punches throw what they hit, and each hand you break on someone gives 4 Regrowth instead of 2.

branches.name: Adrenal Rush
branches.description: Spend up to 40 Regrowth: heal 4, plus one per 5 spent, and run on Speed II, Haste and Jump Boost for 8 seconds.

branches.name: Callus
branches.description: Adaptation remembers the last three kinds of harm at once instead of only the last.

branches.name: Adaptation
branches.description: Tense up and let your body learn: for thirty seconds, each repeat of the same kind of harm hurts 40% less.

branches.name: Thick Skin
branches.description: Adaptation reduces repeated harm by 60%.

branches.name: Perfect Adaptation
branches.description: Fire and wither can no longer hurt you.

branches.name: Back on Your Feet
branches.description: Getting back up from being down throws a heartbeat that knocks back everything within 5 blocks, and you rise with Strength for 10 seconds.

branches.name: Play Dead
branches.description: Drop as if dead for up to 4 seconds. Monsters within 16 blocks lose you and can't pick you again while you lie there, and you heal 1 every half second. Press again to get up: your next melee hit within 3 seconds lands 6 harder.

branches.name: Quick Recovery
branches.description: Your time on the ground is a third shorter, and Rapid Mending is ready the moment you get up.

branches.name: Revive
branches.description: Both hands on a friend's chest: pull a friend below 30% health back to 60%, with Regeneration II.

branches.name: Field Medic
branches.description: Revive reaches 16 blocks.

branches.name: Second Wind
branches.description: Revive also clears harmful effects and grants strong absorption.

styles.name: Vital Burst
styles.description: Spend 4 of your own health in a double heartbeat of light. Foes within 6 blocks take 10 + 2 per tier, and you heal 2 for each one hit.

styles.name: Undying
styles.description: For 6 seconds nothing can take your last heart. When it ends you heal 30% of your health.

styles.name: Lifebloom
styles.description: A tree of light grows where you stand for 12 seconds. Friends within 7 blocks heal steadily and are cured of poison and wither.

branches.name: Still Point
branches.description: While your Still World holds, Fold Space costs nothing and waits on no cooldown, three times.

branches.name: Selective Stasis
branches.description: Stop one creature you can see within 20 blocks for 4 to 5.5 seconds: it can't move, think or act. Your blows on it wait and land together when time resumes; press again to snap your fingers and let it go early. One creature at a time.

branches.name: Compound Interest
branches.description: Blows you store in stopped time grow as they pile up: each adds a tenth to them all (up to 60% more), and a creature holds half again as much.

branches.name: Stasis Seal
branches.description: Frame a point up to 24 blocks away and seal it in stopped time for eight seconds. Shots that fly in hang there, and enemies that walk in stop for two seconds (your blows on them wait). Press again to throw everything inside where you look.

branches.name: Held Volley
branches.description: Your own shots wait in the seal too, and it reaches five blocks from its centre instead of three: fill it, then throw them all at once.

branches.name: Return to Sender
branches.description: Shots you throw from the seal become yours, fly half again as fast and curve onto the enemy nearest your aim.

branches.name: Behind You
branches.description: Fold Space aimed at an enemy lands you just behind it, facing it. Your next hit on it within two seconds lands 50% harder, or twice as hard if it is held in stopped time.

branches.name: Spatial Anchor
branches.description: Shift + key plants a gold clock on safe ground. Press normally to return to it within 512 blocks in the same world, bringing up to three friends beside you (teammates, players crouching, your pets). The destination must be loaded and clear.

branches.name: Snap Shut
branches.description: The hole Fold Space leaves behind snaps shut: enemies within 3 blocks of where you stood are dragged into it, take 3 damage and are slowed.

branches.name: Moment's Edge
branches.description: Time stops for a heartbeat. You fold from enemy to enemy, up to three within 12 blocks, cutting each for 6 + level and landing behind the last. They feel every cut at once when time resumes.

branches.name: Long Edge
branches.description: Moment's Edge reaches 20 blocks and five enemies.

branches.name: Thousand Cuts
branches.description: Moment's Edge cuts each enemy twice, and they stay stopped for two seconds after the last cut: every blow you add waits and lands with the rest.

branches.name: Singularity
branches.description: Fold space to a point where you aim. For five seconds it drags enemies within 10 blocks into a spiralling orbit, tears at anything at its core, and swallows hostile projectiles and loose items. Then it collapses in a shockwave, and what it swallowed lands at your feet.

branches.name: Foreknowledge
branches.description: When you Rewrite the Moment or take a Second Chance, you remember who hurt you in the time you undid. For ten seconds they are marked to you alone, and your hits on them land 30% harder.

branches.name: Second Chance
branches.description: Turn your own clock back five seconds: where you stood, the health you lost and your fire. Inventories, blocks and everyone else stay as they are. Needs five seconds of history.

branches.name: Shared Hour
branches.description: Second Chance takes friends within 6 blocks back through their own five seconds too: where they stood, the health they lost and their fire.

branches.name: Fast Forward
branches.description: Wind a creature's clock five seconds ahead (up to 20 blocks). An enemy suffers its next five seconds of burning, poison and wither at once and is left weary; if you hold it in stopped time, its stored blows land now. A friend's harmful effects run down instead, and their healing arrives early. Aimed at nothing, plants and young animals near you grow up.

branches.name: Wider Era
branches.description: Fast Forward also reaches every creature within 4 blocks of the one you aim at, each as friend or foe, and grows plants five blocks round you instead of three.

branches.name: Era's End
branches.description: Fast Forward on an enemy brings back every blow you landed on it in the last five seconds, at half strength, all at once.

styles.name: Hour Hand
styles.description: A clock face opens around you and its hour hand, a blade of gold light 7 blocks long, sweeps once all the way round. Every foe it passes takes 9 + 2 per tier and is slowed.

styles.name: Time Loop
styles.description: Mark this moment for 6 seconds. When the loop closes you return to the health you had when it opened, with harmful effects undone. A blow that would kill you closes it early instead.

styles.name: Borrowed Time
styles.description: Lend time to everyone near you. You and friends within 10 blocks move and work much faster for 8 seconds and regain 15 stamina.

branches.name: Searing Palms
branches.description: Radiant Heat reaches 11 blocks instead of 8 and throws harder. Catching three or more enemies in one cone builds twice the Core.

branches.name: Gamma Lance
branches.description: A narrow lance of gamma light pierces everything on a line up to 40 blocks: 8 + level damage and a stage of Radiation Sickness. With 15 Core to spend, it spends it and strikes twice as hard with two stages.

branches.name: Focused Beam
branches.description: Meltdown Beam deals 30% more damage.

branches.name: Heat Vent
branches.description: Dump up to 30 Core into a roaring cone 9 blocks ahead. It burns harder the more you vent, sets enemies alight and throws them back.

branches.name: Chain Vent
branches.description: Every sick enemy Heat Vent hits bursts as if it had died: the chain reaction spreads its sickness to everything around it.

branches.name: Supercritical
branches.description: While your Core is Critical, every enemy you kill bursts in a small blast that hurts, doses and throws what is near and feeds you 5 Core.

branches.name: Hot Start
branches.description: Core cools half as fast while you rest, so you stay Hot between fights.

branches.name: Lead Skin
branches.description: Condense a layer of lead over your skin: Resistance II for 8 seconds, and anything that hits you in melee meanwhile is dosed.

branches.name: Safe Venting
branches.description: EMP vents 40 Core instead of 25 and turns half of it into stamina. Every pulse of the Meltdown Beam restores a point of stamina.

branches.name: Reactor Core
branches.description: Turn up to 20 Core into stamina, and give friends within 6 blocks a burst of stamina.

branches.name: Power Transfer
branches.description: Reactor Core converts up to 40 Core, and the friends you power dig faster.

branches.name: Breeder Reactor
branches.description: Once a minute, reaching 100 Core runs you hot instead of failing: ten seconds of Overdrive in which your radiation hits twice as hard. Vent before it ends, or containment fails as usual.

branches.name: Fallout Boots
branches.description: Fission Leap's launch leaves the ground you left contaminated for 5 seconds.

branches.name: Decontaminate
branches.description: Purge harmful effects and flames from yourself and friends within 8 blocks, then grant 8 seconds of Fire Resistance.

branches.name: Second Leap
branches.description: Fission Leap can launch you once more in mid-air before you slam.

branches.name: Glowing Path
branches.description: For 8 seconds you leave contaminated ground wherever you walk.

branches.name: Half-Life
branches.description: The ground you contaminate stays dangerous twice as long and doses two stages at a time.

branches.name: Catastrophe
branches.description: A Fission Leap slam into ground you contaminated sets it off: a blast 60% wider and half again as strong, leaving a bigger patch.

styles.name: Ground Zero
styles.description: Throw a mote of your core up to 32 blocks. It hangs there glowing for a second and a half, then goes off: the Odessa blast in small, with its flash, fireball and mushroom cloud. Foes within 9 blocks take 10 + 2 per tier, plus up to 12 more near the centre, are irradiated and thrown. No blocks are broken.

styles.name: Containment Dome
styles.description: Lead-glass panels lock into a dome 5 blocks across around where you stand for 8 seconds. Hostile projectiles that reach it are swallowed, you and your friends inside take 35% less damage, and foes inside are slowly irradiated.

styles.name: Reactor Hearth
styles.description: Raise a reactor's glowing heart at your feet for 10 seconds. Friends within 7 blocks gain absorption, and while they stay near it they regenerate quickly, dig faster and regain stamina.

branches.name: Braced Voice
branches.description: Crouch to brace as you tap the Cry and it focuses instead of throwing you back: a narrower cone that strikes 40% harder and leaves everything it hits Ringing.

branches.name: Focused Shriek
branches.description: Cup a hand to your mouth and put the whole voice through one point up to 40 blocks away: 9 + level damage and a shove, and the target is left Ringing for six seconds. Your next sonic hit on a Ringing enemy shatters the ring for 6 more damage and 10 Resonance.

branches.name: Feedback Loop
branches.description: A Cry or Crescendo that passes through your own Wall of Sound comes out amplified: the Cry half again as hard and twelve blocks longer, the Crescendo 30% harder and eight blocks longer.

branches.name: Shatter Note
branches.description: Snap your fingers at a point up to 24 blocks away and find its frequency: glass, ice and leaves around it shatter, and enemies there take 4 and are left Ringing.

branches.name: Wider Shatter
branches.description: Shatter Note breaks a 5x5x5 area, and a Shatter Note near your own Resonant Note breaks it harmonic, for free.

branches.name: Resonant Breaker
branches.description: Shatter Note also breaks stone, dirt and wood (hardness up to 3), and stuns enemies that were already Ringing for a second. Protected ground is always spared.

branches.name: Perfect Pitch
branches.description: Enemies your Resonant Note lures glow for you through walls, and they come to it faster.

branches.name: Dissonant Wave
branches.description: Throw your head back and howl clashing notes: visible enemies within 8 blocks take 3 damage, Weakness II for 6 seconds and a strong 4-second slow. Enemies gathered at your Resonant Note take it twice and are thrown into the note.

branches.name: Siren Song
branches.description: Your Resonant Note lures from 24 blocks instead of 16, draws bigger creatures (up to 200 health) and plays four seconds longer.

branches.name: Echo Map
branches.description: A hand to your ear and a sonar sweep only you see: ores within twelve blocks glimmer for you alone.

branches.name: Deep Echo
branches.description: Echo Map reaches twenty blocks, and every enemy its sweep passes is left Ringing.

branches.name: Cartographer
branches.description: Echo Map also outlines every creature within 32 blocks and exposes the unseen.

branches.name: Sympathetic Strings
branches.description: Your friends' shots pass through your Wall of Sound instead of turning back, and come out half again as fast and hard.

branches.name: Resonant Guard
branches.description: Cross your arms and hum: Resistance for 5 seconds and a shell of standing waves 7 blocks across that turns back incoming shots. Every shot it turns builds 4 Resonance.

branches.name: Sustain
branches.description: Your Wall of Sound and Resonant Guard last half again as long, and your Resonance doesn't fade while either stands.

branches.name: Quiet Zone
branches.description: A finger to your lips: a field of silence six blocks across for ten seconds. Mobs inside lose their targets and can't pick new ones.

branches.name: Long Silence
branches.description: The Quiet Zone lasts fifteen seconds.

branches.name: Harmonist
branches.description: Friends inside the Quiet Zone slowly heal.

styles.name: Resonance Cascade
styles.description: Stack standing waves over a point up to 24 blocks away until they fold in on themselves: foes within 4.5 blocks take 12 + 2 per tier and are left staggered and weak.

styles.name: Silence Dome
styles.description: A dome of dead air 5 blocks across stands where you are for 8 seconds. Projectiles inside lose their speed and drop; foes inside are weakened.

styles.name: Battle Hymn
styles.description: A five-line staff of light circles you. You and friends within 12 blocks gain strength and speed for 10 seconds.

branches.name: Efficient Stride
branches.description: Reduce activation stamina costs by 10%.

branches.name: Reflex Focus
branches.description: For 6 seconds, dodge an incoming projectile sideways if there is a clear escape path. Each successful dodge costs 3 stamina; at most once per second.

branches.name: Efficient Stride Mastery
branches.description: Reduce activation stamina costs by another 15% (25% total).

branches.name: Speed Mirage
branches.description: Afterimages fill the air for six seconds: mobs hunting you lose the trail and stumble.

branches.name: Lingering Mirage
branches.description: The mirage lasts ten seconds.

branches.name: Time Remnant
branches.description: Your remnants strike enemies within four blocks every second.

branches.name: Kinetic Force
branches.description: Increase your outgoing attack damage by 10% while your awakened power is active.

branches.name: Momentum Strike
branches.description: Rush a visible enemy up to 40 blocks away along a clear path and land a powerful strike. Cannot pass through walls.

branches.name: Kinetic Force Mastery
branches.description: Increase outgoing attack damage by another 15% (25% total). Suppressed during an Eclipse.

branches.name: Lightning Throw
branches.description: Spend your Momentum (at least 30) to hurl a bolt of your own lightning at an enemy within 32 blocks. It counts as electricity.

branches.name: Charged Throw
branches.description: The bolt chains to two more enemies.

branches.name: Infinite Mass Punch
branches.description: At 90 Momentum or more, your next punch spends it all for a devastating, launching blow.

branches.name: Quick Recovery
branches.description: Reduce ability cooldowns by 10%.

branches.name: Slipstream Rescue
branches.description: Carry a nearby villager, friendly creature, teammate or crouching player up to 12 blocks ahead. Both bodies need a clear path.

branches.name: Quick Recovery Mastery
branches.description: Reduce ability cooldowns by another 15% (25% total).

branches.name: Perception
branches.description: For six seconds, other players across the server and entities within 12 blocks move at a third of their speed. Incoming shots slow enough to catch.

branches.name: Long Perception
branches.description: Perception lasts ten seconds and reaches entities and projectiles within 16 blocks.

branches.name: Flash Time
branches.description: Other players and nearby entities slow to a sixth while Perception lasts. Incoming shots keep moving so you can catch them.

styles.name: Lightning Flurry
styles.description: Strike up to six foes within 12 blocks one after another, faster than they can see, for 5 + tier each, then stand where you started.

styles.name: Phase Blur
styles.description: Vibrate too fast to hit for 6 seconds: each blow has a 60% chance to pass straight through you.

styles.name: Relay Run
styles.description: Run to every friend within 24 blocks and bring them back to your side in an instant. All of you are faster for 6 seconds.

branches.name: Clear Sight
branches.description: Reduce activation stamina costs by 10%.

branches.name: Object Reading
branches.description: Read the next lead for The Last Signal and briefly outline nearby villagers, including sleepers through walls.

branches.name: Clear Sight Mastery
branches.description: Reduce activation stamina costs by another 15%.

branches.name: Foresight
branches.description: For ten seconds, sidestep the next three blows you see coming.

branches.name: Clear Sight
branches.description: Foresight sidesteps five blows.

branches.name: Fatekeeper
branches.description: Teammates within eight blocks also sidestep one blow.

branches.name: Ink Pressure
branches.description: Increase outgoing damage by 10% while awakened.

branches.name: Red Margin
branches.description: Mark the intentions of three nearby enemies. Each loses its next damaging attack against you or a nearby friend during four seconds.

branches.name: Ink Pressure Mastery
branches.description: Increase outgoing damage by another 15%.

branches.name: Find the Path
branches.description: A vision points the way to the nearest Helixite within 32 blocks.

branches.name: Far Sight
branches.description: Find the Path searches 64 blocks.

branches.name: The Painter
branches.description: The vision also shows where the nearest village lies.

branches.name: Shared Perspective
branches.description: Reduce cooldowns by 10%.

branches.name: Omen Relay
branches.description: Share six seconds of committed-threat warnings with nearby scoreboard teammates.

branches.name: Shared Perspective Mastery
branches.description: Reduce cooldowns by another 15%.

branches.name: Shared Omen
branches.description: For eight seconds, any teammate within 24 blocks braces the moment something chooses them as prey.

branches.name: Long Omen
branches.description: Shared Omen lasts twelve seconds.

branches.name: Isaac's Gift
branches.description: Bracing also grants absorption.

styles.name: Foretold Strike
styles.description: Paint a circle 3 blocks across on the ground up to 24 blocks away and cross it out. Two seconds later the painting comes true: whoever is still inside takes 16 + 3 per tier.

styles.name: Branching Paths
styles.description: See three futures of yourself for 6 seconds. The first blow that would land misses: you are already standing in the safest of them.

styles.name: Prophecy Canvas
styles.description: Paint the next fifteen seconds for everyone near you. Friends within 12 blocks are lucky, and a blow that would kill one of them leaves them on their last heart instead.

branches.name: Kindling
branches.description: Direct Cinder Spear hits build 4 extra Heat per cast.

branches.name: Ember Lash
branches.description: Lash a visible enemy within 40 blocks for 6 + level damage and five seconds of burning, then reel them toward you for 0.4 seconds. The tether stops at three blocks or when cover breaks the connection.

branches.name: Flashpoint
branches.description: Detonating a burning enemy with Cinder Spear refunds 8 Heat per cast.

branches.name: Ember Mine
branches.description: Hide up to two embers for 40 seconds. Enemies, a fully charged Cinder Spear, or Blue Lance can trigger an armed ember. It gives a visible warning for 0.4 seconds before erupting for 6 + level fire damage.

branches.name: Long Fuse
branches.description: Keep three Ember Mines at once, and widen each eruption from 2.5 to 4 blocks.

branches.name: Wildfire
branches.description: Mine eruptions leave a ring of real fire and prime your other armed mines within eight blocks and in sight. Each gets its own warning.

branches.name: Stoke
branches.description: Dragon's Breath builds 2 extra Heat per pulse that hits an enemy.

branches.name: Heat Mantle
branches.description: Raise rotating flame plates for eight seconds: Resistance, a burning aura within 2.5 blocks, and hostile-projectile interception within 3. Each consumed projectile feeds 2 Heat, up to 8 every quarter-second. Allied shots pass through.

branches.name: Furnace
branches.description: Blue Dragon's Breath keeps a Firestorm fanned for 2.4 seconds instead of 1.2.

branches.name: Blue Lance
branches.description: Pierce 24 blocks for (8 + level) x 1.5 blue fire damage. The seam stays for 0.6 seconds and pulses for 2.5 damage every four ticks. It primes armed Ember Mines in its path. Solid cover and water stop it.

branches.name: White Heat
branches.description: Your flames turn blue at 60 Heat instead of 80.

branches.name: Flint's Fury
branches.description: Sunfall always burns blue and reaches three blocks farther.

branches.name: Warm Blood
branches.description: Standing in fire or lava builds 5 Heat per second in addition to restoring stamina.

branches.name: Cauterizing Flame
branches.description: Seal the wounds of an injured or afflicted friend in sight within eight blocks, or yourself: heal 4 + level, clear harmful effects and extinguish flames. Automatically spends 20 Heat, when available, for four health of absorption lasting five seconds.

branches.name: Hearthkeeper
branches.description: Cauterizing Flame spends 10 Heat for absorption. Fire Shepherd recovers 6 Heat per burning friend rescued, up to 18.

branches.name: Fire Shepherd
branches.description: Draw in up to 32 nearby fires, restoring stamina and health plus 2 Heat per fire, up to 40 Heat. Extinguishes burning friends within five blocks and heals them for 2. Thaw also releases nearby friends from cold.

branches.name: Thaw
branches.description: Fire Shepherd also thaws frozen and chilled friends within five blocks.

branches.name: Pillar of Flame
branches.description: Flame Flight ascends faster and hovering costs only four stamina per second.

branches.name: Phoenix
branches.description: Release a firebird that favors burning enemies. It dives through up to three foes, or four from tier 5, then returns to heal you and restore Heat for each strike. A Phoenix cast at blue Heat burns hotter.

styles.name: Starfall
styles.description: A star falls from high in the sky, trailing a long burning tail, onto a point up to 48 blocks away. Foes within 5 blocks of where it lands take 12 + 2 per tier, burn and are thrown. A pillar of fire stands there a moment after.

styles.name: Ember Shroud
styles.description: Wrap yourself in turning flame for 8 seconds: arrows and other projectiles burn up before they reach you, anyone who strikes you is set alight, and fire cannot hurt you.

styles.name: Hearthfire
styles.description: Light a hearth at your feet for 12 seconds. Friends within 6 blocks heal steadily, are thawed and cannot burn.

branches.name: Quiet Light
branches.description: Walking while faded builds half as much Exposure, and friends who share your Fade build none at all.

branches.name: Vanishing Touch
branches.description: Make the friend, pet or object under your aim, up to 16 blocks away, invisible for 20 seconds: a player, a tamed animal, a villager, a boat, a cart or a dropped item. Hunters lose track of a hidden creature.

branches.name: Unseen Constructs
branches.description: Your shields, bridges, barriers, bubbles and disc are invisible to everyone except you and your friends. Foes walk into walls they cannot see.

branches.name: Vanishing Squad
branches.description: You and every friend, pet and companion within 8 blocks fade for 10 seconds. Hunters lose all of you at once.

branches.name: Long Vanish
branches.description: Vanishing Touch reaches 24 blocks and lasts 40 seconds; Vanishing Squad reaches 12 blocks and lasts 20 seconds.

branches.name: Unseen Force
branches.description: Force Push, Bubble, Crush, Pinpoint, Kinetic Shell and Force Nova cast while you are fully unseen hit 40% harder and do not give you away.

branches.name: Wide Lens
branches.description: Lens Shield is half again as wide and holds for 5 seconds instead of 3, giving it longer to store Pressure.

branches.name: Force Barrier
branches.description: Raise a solid wall of force 7 blocks wide and 4 tall where you aim, up to 20 blocks away, for 10 seconds. Nothing walks or shoots through it.

branches.name: Safety Net
branches.description: A pad of force catches you when you fall 6 blocks or more, so the landing does no harm. Once every 10 seconds.

branches.name: Force Disc
branches.description: Ride a disc of force for 8 seconds. It glides wherever you look; crouch to step off and drift down.

branches.name: Steady Disc
branches.description: Force Disc lasts 16 seconds, and Force Bridges stand for 20 seconds instead of 10.

branches.name: Rebound
branches.description: Projectiles stopped by your Lens Shield, Force Push, Force Barrier or a shelter bubble fly back at whoever fired them.

branches.name: Hard Push
branches.description: Force Push reaches 14 blocks instead of 10 and throws half again as hard.

branches.name: Pinpoint
branches.description: Flick a bead of force at a foe up to 24 blocks away: 6 + level damage, and it pops them into the air, ready for a bubble.

branches.name: Tight Seal
branches.description: Bubbles hold foes for 8 seconds instead of 5, and crushing them deals 50% more damage.

branches.name: Kinetic Shell
branches.description: Seal up to 4 foes within 6 blocks of where you aim in bubbles for 3 seconds. One press of Crush closes them all.

branches.name: Pressure Chain
branches.description: A crushed bubble bursts outward: foes within 4 blocks of it take half the crush damage and are thrown.

branches.name: Implosion
branches.description: Force Nova pulls foes within 16 blocks toward you while it gathers, then seals the six nearest in bubbles, so the burst strikes them all for double damage.

styles.name: Shadow Strike
styles.description: Vanish and strike up to three foes within 10 blocks from behind, one after another, for half again as much as usual. You stay unseen for 3 seconds afterwards.

styles.name: Refraction Cloak
styles.description: Bend light around yourself for 6 seconds: you are invisible and projectiles curve away from you.

styles.name: Prism Haze
styles.description: A haze of broken light settles 6 blocks around you for 10 seconds. Friends inside are unseen and regenerate; foes inside are blinded.

branches.name: Through the Wall
branches.description: Reach Through finds an enemy behind up to two blocks of wall, and a hand that comes out of a wall lands 3 harder.

branches.name: Pass Through
branches.description: Run straight through the enemy you look at within 10 blocks and come out behind them, facing them: 4 + level damage that ignores armor, they can't heal for three seconds, and they're slowed for two.

branches.name: Inside Knowledge
branches.description: A body your hand has been inside can't heal for twice as long, and for that time your Ghost punches on it land at full strength, even at Full Ghost.

branches.name: Phase Carry
branches.description: Pass through the wall ahead, bringing up to three friends. For three seconds afterward, shots pass straight through them.

branches.name: Ambush
branches.description: Stepping out of a wall primes your hand for three seconds: your next Reach Through costs nothing, waits on no cooldown and lands 4 harder.

branches.name: Ghost Network
branches.description: Every wall you pass stays open for six seconds: friends and your pets who walk into either side come out of the other. You come out at Full Ghost, free of upkeep, for two seconds.

branches.name: Pile Driver
branches.description: At Full Dense, a punch drives a standing enemy knee-deep into the ground for a second and a half (each enemy once every eight seconds).

branches.name: Harden
branches.description: Snap to Full Dense, free of upkeep, for six seconds, banking the weight of every blow you take. Press again to Rebound: it all comes back out of the ground as a shockwave (wider and harder the more you took, up to 18 damage).

branches.name: Crater Landing
branches.description: Your shockwaves (a Full Dense landing, Bedrock Slam, Rebound) root the enemies they hit knee-deep for two seconds instead of throwing them.

branches.name: Sinkhole
branches.description: Press down on a point up to 16 blocks away: after half a second the ground there goes soft for three seconds, and every enemy in it, or who walks in, sinks waist-deep for two.

branches.name: Set in Stone
branches.description: Enemies you embed can't struggle free, and each blow you land on one at Dense holds it a second longer (up to four).

branches.name: Entombed
branches.description: Press Embed at an enemy you already hold in the ground and it closes right over them for three seconds: they take damage every second, then the ground throws them back up.

branches.name: Uproot
branches.description: Surfacing under an enemy you hold in the ground tears them out of it: the uppercut deals double and throws them twice as high. Anyone you surface under can't heal for two seconds.

branches.name: Fade Through
branches.description: Three seconds at Full Ghost, free of upkeep. Every enemy you drift through takes 3 + half your level, is slowed, and can't heal for two seconds.

branches.name: Grasp from Below
branches.description: Reach Through while you are sunk grabs the nearest enemy standing above you by the ankles: they're pulled waist-deep for two seconds and can't heal.

branches.name: Phase Fall
branches.description: Drop through the floor to the open space below with up to three friends. Shift rises instead.

branches.name: Deep Fall
branches.description: Phase Fall reaches 32 blocks, and dropping through at Dense lands as heavily as if you had fallen the whole way: a shockwave instead of a step.

branches.name: Untouchable
branches.description: Holding a Ghost or Dense notch drains stamina half as fast, and a blow that would take you below a third of your health passes through you as you slip to Full Ghost for two seconds (once every 30 seconds).

styles.name: Phase Eruption
styles.description: Sink into the ground and erupt beneath a point up to 20 blocks away. Foes within 3.5 blocks take 10 + 2 per tier and are thrown into the air.

styles.name: Dense Bulwark
styles.description: Make yourself unbelievably dense for 8 seconds: you take far less damage and cannot be moved, but you are slow.

styles.name: Phase Field
styles.description: Loosen everyone near you. For 8 seconds, projectiles pass straight through you and friends within 8 blocks, and other damage is reduced.

branches.name: Open Mind
branches.description: Reduce activation stamina costs by 10%.

branches.name: Borrowed Strike
branches.description: Lash out with a borrowed instinct at an enemy up to 40 blocks away: 6 + level damage.

branches.name: Open Mind Mastery
branches.description: Reduce activation stamina costs by another 15% (25% total).

branches.name: Sense Powers
branches.description: Feel every powered person and Sylar within 48 blocks; they glow for you for eight seconds.

branches.name: Quick Study
branches.description: You feel powers from 20 blocks away, even through walls.

branches.name: Sylar's Mirror
branches.description: Touching Sylar keeps everything he has stolen that you have room for, and you can keep one more set.

branches.name: Strong Echo
branches.description: Increase outgoing attack damage by 10%.

branches.name: Empathic Surge
branches.description: You and nearby teammates feel each other's strength: Strength for eight seconds.

branches.name: Strong Echo Mastery
branches.description: Increase outgoing attack damage by another 15% (25% total).

branches.name: Overcharge
branches.description: Your next Echo uses the borrowed power at your full level.

branches.name: Twin Echo
branches.description: An overcharged Echo recovers twice as fast.

branches.name: Peter's Burden
branches.description: Echoes cost 25% less stamina.

branches.name: Steady Heart
branches.description: Reduce ability cooldowns by 10%.

branches.name: Calm
branches.description: Soothe yourself and nearby teammates, clearing harmful effects.

branches.name: Steady Heart Mastery
branches.description: Reduce ability cooldowns by another 15% (25% total).

branches.name: Absorb Pain
branches.description: Take a friend's harmful effects onto yourself at half duration, and heal them for 4.

branches.name: Shared Healing
branches.description: Absorb Pain heals 8.

branches.name: Empath's Calm
branches.description: Poison and wither cannot take hold of you.

styles.name: Prismatic Overflow
styles.description: Let every power you remember out at once. Foes within 7 blocks take 8 + 2 per remembered power + tier, burn, slow and glow.

styles.name: Empathic Ward
styles.description: Three sigils of borrowed colour circle you for 8 seconds. Each one catches a blow that would have landed, and gives you 5 stamina.

styles.name: Kindred Light
styles.description: You and friends within 12 blocks heal 4 plus one per remembered power, and are cleansed of harmful effects.

branches.name: Air Gap
branches.description: Handshake can bridge one empty block between physical conductors. The gap must actually be empty; walls cannot become cables.

branches.name: Batch Instruction
branches.description: Send ON / OPEN to up to six linked controls. Hold Shift for OFF / CLOSED. Every real device checks its owner's permission separately.

branches.name: Safety Interlock
branches.description: Remote commands refuse to close doors, gates and trapdoors occupied by any living body. Build an evacuation corridor without closing it on the people using it.

branches.name: Delayed Instruction
branches.description: Queue the aimed linked control to toggle in three seconds. Shift queues OFF / CLOSED. An intervening manual command cancels your instruction.

branches.name: Echo Instruction
branches.description: Delayed Instructions return their devices to the previous state two seconds after firing. A later manual command or replacement block is never overwritten.

branches.name: Clockwork
branches.description: Your Delayed Instruction fans out across six linked controls, firing one every eight ticks. Echo Instruction makes the whole sequence unwind after each step.

branches.name: Motion Sensor
branches.description: Tripwire reads a moving body's recent path as well as its current position. Fast intruders can no longer simply skip through a thin line between checks.

branches.name: Sentry Seal
branches.description: Prepare a three-block proximity trap above a linked relay for thirty seconds. Its first hostile intruder is slammed back and briefly slowed; incoming arrows are intercepted when it fires.

branches.name: Interrupt Request
branches.description: Triggered relay traps interrupt eating, bow drawing and other held item use, and break an intruder's sprint. They do not suppress an entire ability set.

branches.name: Kill Switch
branches.description: Switch an active linked controller OFF / CLOSED for five seconds, then safely restore its original state. The command never resurrects a broken or replaced device.

branches.name: Black Box
branches.description: A real hostile arrow interception saves one spare trap charge. Your next Tripwire can stop two different intruders instead of one. The spare cannot be stockpiled.

branches.name: Airlock
branches.description: When a relay trap catches an intruder, nearby enrolled open doors, gates and trapdoors close for three seconds, then return to their original state. Build an actual containment corridor.

branches.name: Flywheel
branches.description: Hostile arrow interceptions store up to three packets of momentum. Your next triggered relay trap spends them for a stronger physical recoil instead of adding free damage.

branches.name: Winchline
branches.description: A linked relay winches the nearest visible hostile within seven blocks towards itself for up to three seconds. Cover and collision break the tether.

branches.name: Counterweight
branches.description: Hold Shift with Winchline to pull yourself towards the aimed relay instead. Vault along a prepared route without teleporting, phasing or leaving flight flags behind.

branches.name: Domino Engine
branches.description: Send a fast mechanical recoil through twelve enrolled relays, one every four ticks. Each enemy can be struck only once by the sequence. Prepare a cable-lined corridor before the fight.

branches.name: Recoil Circuit
branches.description: Domino Engine pushes targets along the arriving relay link rather than radially away. Your circuit's physical layout becomes a knockback conveyor.

branches.name: Return to Sender
branches.description: Intercept can send an arrow back at its hostile shooter when the return route is clear. The arrow becomes your shot; damage, cover, friendly fire and server PvP rules still apply.

styles.name: Drone Swarm
styles.description: Six drones of light circle you for 8 seconds, shooting the three nearest foes in sight within 12 blocks every three quarters of a second.

styles.name: Firewall
styles.description: Raise a hologram wall 5 blocks wide in front of you for 10 seconds. It deletes projectiles that cross it and burns and throws back anyone who tries.

styles.name: Overclock
styles.description: Overclock everyone near you: you and friends within 12 blocks work much faster and move faster for 10 seconds, and regain 10 stamina.

branches.name: Load-Bearing
branches.description: Landing on your own assembled matter absorbs your fall completely.

branches.name: Switchback
branches.description: Fold a narrow staircase of matter through a right-angle turn toward your aim. Look up to climb, down to descend.

branches.name: Buttressed Corners
branches.description: Foldwall gains a wing folded back at each side to cover your flanks.

branches.name: Drawbridge
branches.description: Project a narrow twenty-block crossing over a gap. Cast again to retract that crossing from its far end.

branches.name: Snap Rails
branches.description: Switchback and Drawbridge grow guard posts along both edges as they reach out.

branches.name: Living Blueprint
branches.description: Sentinel Engine remembers its turrets. While you stay near, it rebuilds a broken turret cell every half-second.

branches.name: Bank Shot
branches.description: Your Shards ricochet once from your own assembled walls instead of stopping, making your cover part of your aim.

branches.name: Scattershot
branches.description: Tear five Shards from the ground and launch them in a fan. Each flies and collides on its own, and cover stops them.

branches.name: Recall Angle
branches.description: A banked Shard can turn toward a visible enemy near the reflection point. The wall becomes a controlled firing angle.

branches.name: Faultline
branches.description: Pillars of matter burst up in a travelling line over solid ground, launching nearby enemies upward without harming allies or replacing terrain.

branches.name: Unstable Lattice
branches.description: Deliberately dismantling a shape releases up to six of its cells as outward Shards. It returns no items.

branches.name: Splinter Storm
branches.description: A direct Shard hit splits into two smaller fragments aimed at other visible enemies nearby. Fragments cannot split again.

branches.name: Secret Threshold
branches.description: Empty-hand right-click your own matter to open a two-block doorway. You can escape or change a firing angle without mining.

branches.name: Folded Shelter
branches.description: Raise a snug, roofed hut of matter round yourself with a doorway behind you. Occupied cells are always skipped.

branches.name: Clean Exit
branches.description: Shelters have a broad rear exit so your team can leave together; their front and roof remain closed.

branches.name: Rescue Cradle
branches.description: Aim at a consenting teammate or use it on yourself. Build a safety floor two blocks below them, even over a void.

branches.name: Pressure Valve
branches.description: A melee attacker striking you beside your own matter is blasted backward. The valve needs two seconds to reset.

branches.name: Second Foundation
branches.description: Once a minute, a fatal hit raises an emergency shelter round you and leaves you at one health. It needs space for at least four cells.

styles.name: Forge Cannon
styles.description: Assemble a cannon of crystal over your shoulder and fire five slugs at what you are looking at, each for 5 + tier.

styles.name: Bulwark Lattice
styles.description: Crystal panels lock into a shell around you for 8 seconds: extra absorption hearts, and projectiles shatter against it.

styles.name: Mending Lattice
styles.description: Crystal lace winds around you and friends within 10 blocks, giving absorption and regeneration for 8 seconds.

branches.name: Through the Seam
branches.description: A Vibe Blast that crosses one of your open Breaches carries on out of the other mouth with the range it had left.

branches.name: Vibe Lance
branches.description: Draw your off hand in and fire a narrow, hard-hitting wave up to 27 blocks.

branches.name: Return Address
branches.description: Each shot Breach Guard catches marks whoever fired it, as if you had read them.

branches.name: Backscatter
branches.description: Each projectile stored in Breach Guard adds more damage to Return Fire.

branches.name: Reverb
branches.description: Fire a broad double-palm blast that hurls enemies farther.

branches.name: Overflow
branches.description: Return Fire with three or more banked impacts collapses into interference where it stops, damaging and slowing enemies within three blocks.

branches.name: Slingshot
branches.description: For three seconds after you cross your own Breach, your next blast fires at once and hits 30% harder.

branches.name: Attune Frequency
branches.description: Save the world, position and facing where you are standing for World Frequency.

branches.name: World Frequency
branches.description: Hold Shift and cast Breach to open a link to your saved location, including in another dimension.

branches.name: Wayfarer
branches.description: Crossing your linked breach grants Speed for five seconds.

branches.name: Flashstep
branches.description: Snap through a tiny breach to safe ground up to 11 blocks away.

branches.name: Safe Horizon
branches.description: Anyone who crosses your linked breaches loses their fire and gains Resistance for four seconds.

branches.name: Residual Sense
branches.description: Anyone who hurts you leaves a residue: they are marked for six seconds, as if you had read them.

branches.name: Co-Vibe
branches.description: Share a longer-range read and its combat echoes with nearby allies.

branches.name: Deep Read
branches.description: Vibe readings replay up to six impacts and mark enemies for longer.

branches.name: Afterimage
branches.description: Blasts that hit a marked enemy also slow them and briefly interrupt Superspeed.

branches.name: Prism Lock
branches.description: Collapse a larger interference zone at longer range, slowing enemies for four seconds.

branches.name: Fixed Point
branches.description: Marked enemies caught in either lock are slowed for five seconds.

styles.name: Crosswave
styles.description: Throw two diverging wave fronts from your palms with a broad concussion.

styles.name: Mirror Breach
styles.description: Open a wider defensive breach for five seconds. Return its stored impact with Breach Guard.

styles.name: Sanctuary Breach
styles.description: Open an evacuation route that extinguishes allies and grants Resistance as they cross.
